description: A shell script for testing various git notes merging scenarios, including setup of commits, notes, conflicts, and different merge strategies.

methods.name: verify_notes
methods.description: Verifies the notes of a specific reference against expected data, comparing git notes and log output.

methods.name: verify_fanout
methods.description: Checks that the notes tree for a given reference exhibits a fanout of exactly 1.

methods.name: verify_no_fanout
methods.description: Checks that the notes tree for a given reference has no fanout (all paths are direct).
